content.title: ‘The Bachelorette’ Cast: Meet Taylor Frankie Paul’s 22 Men — Who May Not Make It to TV
content.text: Skip to main content site categories Home TV TV News ‘The Bachelorette’ Cast: Meet Taylor Frankie Paul’s 22 Men — Who May Not Make It to TV The dating reality series was originally set to premiere Sunday with 'The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives' star as its lead. ABC has since pulled the show — see photos and bios of the men. Published on March 20, 2026 Clockwise from top left: Malik, Doug, Shane, Brandon, Aaron, Michael B, Marcus and Johnnie Evan Mulling/Disney (8) ABC’s decision Thursday to pull Taylor Frankie Paul’s season of The Bachelorette just three days before its scheduled premiere has raised major questions about the franchise. But what about the men? Contestants often take time away from their families, leave jobs and pause their lives to appear on the series. The decision to shelve season 22 followed reports earlier in the week of an alleged domestic incident involving Paul and her ex, Dakota Mortensen, with whom she shares a son. After TMZ published a video Thursday tied to Paul’s 2023 arrest — to which she later pleaded guilty to aggravated assault, as documented on her other reality series, Hulu’s The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives — the network opted not to move forward. “In light of the newly released video that surfaced today, we have made the decision to not move forward with the new season of The Bachelorette at this time, and our focus is on supporting the family,” a Disney Entertainment Television spokesperson said Thursday. Not airing the season could cost the network $30 million or more. Speaking to The Hollywood Reporter earlier this week, Paul acknowledged the toll of the headlines. “It’s been really difficult and heavy, given, you know, all the headlines and what’s going on,” Paul said. “I am handling it like any normal human would, like struggling but trying to show up at the same time.” Paul rose to fame after going viral on TikTok in 2022 amid a “soft swinging” scandal involving MomTok creators and has since starred in four seasons of Mormon Wives, which was recently halted amid the allegations. In a November interview with THR, she encouraged viewers to keep an open mind: “I feel like if you were to ever watch me, hear my story, I think I come off a little bit differently than people would just assume.” The series is produced by Warner Horizon Unscripted Television, part of Warner Bros. Television Group, with Scott Teti serving as executive producer. Below, meet the 22 men ABC had cast to compete for Paul’s final rose — who may now never get their time onscreen — with ABC’s description of each of her suitors. (Read here to find out what Paul told THR about her season’s ending and rumors about her final pick that, she said, were “incorrect spoilers.”) This story originally published on Feb. 23 and has been updated after ABC pulled Paul’s season of The Bachelorette. Aaron, 32Photo : Disney/Evan Mulling Vineyard, Utah Product Manager Aaron is total husband material. With a smile as sweet as his personality, he loves making others feel welcome and radiates positive energy wherever he goes. He can’t wait to get married and takes pride in being a loyal, supportive partner. Aaron is incredibly close with his family and dreams of the day he can start one of his own. A devoted member of the Mormon church and a first-generation American born to immigrant parents, Aaron loves to travel and has even led humanitarian trips around the world. After years of putting others first in both his career and personal life, Aaron is finally ready to focus on his own love story and see if Taylor could be “the one.” Fun Facts: Aaron’s FYP is exclusively food content. Aaron cannot sleep past 7 a.m. Aaron says that while his car is old, it is always shiny. Brad, 29Photo : Disney/Evan Mulling Newport Beach, Calif. Cowboy/Entrepreneur Lassoing for love! If Taylor is searching for a handsome California cowboy, she won’t have to look any further than Brad. His best friend is his horse, Gus, whom he partners with on all his cowboy jobs. When he’s not on the ranch, Brad enjoys swing dancing, hanging at the beach, and listening to Adele. This fearless romantic is ready to start a family and prides himself on being a generous, loving partner. We can’t wait to see if he can giddy up his way into our Bachelorette’s heart. Fun Facts: Brad is working toward getting his private pilot’s license. Brad would have been an incredible gladiator. Brad prefers a white rose to a red one … It’s less basic. Brandon, 28Photo : Disney/Evan Mulling Spearfish, S.D. Loan Officer Brandon is a single dad whose world revolves around his amazing kids. He’s confident, loyal and a total catch. Family means everything to Brandon, and this self-described mama’s boy is looking for a wife to settle down with and build a life. He’s a hopeless romantic who fantasizes over the idea of true love. His idea of the perfect date? A sunset hike, followed by pizza and cuddles on the couch. When Brandon isn’t working or enjoying time with his kids, he loves watching “Peaky Blinders,” rock climbing, and cheering on the Chicago Bears. He is serious about finding love on this journey, so Brandon, let the journey begin. Fun Facts: Brandon’s all-time favorite movie is The Notebook. Brandon loves the smell of roasted marshmallows. Brandon does not do complex card games. Casey, 30Photo : Disney/Evan Mulling Nashville, Tenn. Mechanical Engineer On the surface, Casey is a handsome Nashville guy with striking blue eyes and a six-pack, but beneath it all, he’s an emotionally intelligent romantic. A mechanical engineer who loves all things science and math, Casey is ready to see if he and Taylor have real chemistry. Coming from a big family, he’s excited to meet his future wife and start a family of his own. When he’s not working, Casey enjoys volunteering, 3D printing, and hitting the dance floor for some two-stepping. His love language? Giving gifts. So, Taylor, get ready to be spoiled! Could this be the end of Casey’s search for love? Fingers crossed! Fun Facts: Casey can’t sleep without socks. Casey loves Steve Irwin. If Casey could have any job, he would be the director of a science museum. Christopher, 35Photo : Disney/Evan Mulling Vacaville, Calif. Business Owner With a smile that lights up every room and a naturally charming personality, it’s easy to see why Christopher is such a catch. A proud Air Force veteran and devoted single dad, Christopher is hoping to find the right woman with whom to build a future and possibly grow his family. He’s impressively well-rounded, balancing a love for group fitness and Tupac with an appreciation for nature and art galleries. Having lived in Europe for six years, Christopher dreams of speaking every language in the world. Positive, motivated, and ready for something real, he’s excited to meet Taylor and hopes this journey will lead to a love that truly stands the test of time. Fun Facts: Christopher loves a good psychological thriller. Christopher looks great in a cowboy hat. Christopher prefers his music on vinyl. Clayton, 36Photo : Disney/Evan Mulling Nashville, Tenn. Singer/Songwriter Clayton is a true Southern gentleman who just hasn’t found the right one yet. This talented musician is searching for a love that’s loyal, nurturing, and built to last a lifetime. When he’s not writing or recording music, Clayton enjoys escaping the city to spend time in nature with his dog, Oliver. Clayton is caring, attentive, and more than willing to go above and beyond for the woman he loves. He once even handmade a scrapbook filled with his favorite shared memories. Clayton calls himself a lover boy and is ready to write love songs for the woman of his dreams. He’s beyond excited to meet Taylor and has romantic surprises already planned for her. Fun Facts: Clayton LOVES flower bouquets. Clayton enjoys a good trail ride on horseback. Once Clayton visits Antarctica, he’ll have been to every continent. Conrad, 32Photo : Disney/Evan Mulling Santa Monica, Calif. Startup Founder Conrad has undeniable golden retriever energy. Outgoing, lovable and a total catch, Conrad has an impressive résumé to match his big heart. He holds an MBA from Stanford and started his own business in the men’s fertility sector helping countless couples fulfill their dream of having children. Conrad lives life to the fullest and is more than ready to share it all with his perfect match by his side. A proud mama’s boy, he’s incredibly loyal and a self-described hopeless romantic who loves planning over-the-top dates designed to sweep his lady off her feet. With words of affirmation as his love language, Conrad is hoping Taylor is ready to say exactly how she feels. He’s confident his future wife is out there, and he just might find her in Taylor. Fun Facts: Conrad believes that food is merely a vessel for sauce. Conrad has been to Stagecoach 12 times. Conrad is an Eagle Scout. Doug, 28Photo : Disney/Evan Mulling San Diego, Calif. Ocean Lifeguard Doug knows how to ride the waves of life, literally. As an ocean lifeguard and avid surfer, he’s ready to dive headfirst into this journey with Taylor. When he’s not at the beach, Doug enjoys watching “Friends,” cheering on the Lakers, and spending quality time with his sister. He’s incredibly close with his family and hopes to have a big family of his own someday. At his core, Doug is passionate about helping others and has dedicated his life to keeping people safe. Just as sweet as he is handsome, we can’t wait to see if sparks fly when Doug meets our Bachelorette. Fun Facts: Doug can ride a unicycle. Doug wants to learn guitar so he can serenade someone. Doug’s love language is great banter. Johnnie, 30Photo : Disney/Evan Mulling Massapequa, N.Y. Former Professional Baseball Player Johnnie is a great catch — literally! This former pro baseball player is genuine, charismatic, and ready for a love straight out of the movies. Known as the life of the party, Johnnie thrives in any room he walks into, especially if there’s karaoke and a crowd to hype. His ideal date night is grabbing pizza and simply enjoying each other’s company. In his free time, Johnnie loves cheering on the Mets, hitting the dance floor, and playing team sports with friends. He’s searching for his teammate for life and hopes to finish this journey with Taylor by his side. Fun Facts: Johnnie’s signature dance moves went viral on TikTok. Johnnie describes himself as a hoarder with order. Johnny makes a mean steak. Josh, 28Photo : Disney/Evan Mulling Provo, UtahSales Manager Say hello to Prince Charming! From his energetic, positive personality to his deep love of dad jokes, Josh is a romantic ready for his fairy-tale ending. Hailing from Provo, Josh runs in similar circles as our Bachelorette and feels they have plenty in common … almost destined to be together. Josh is already a homeowner but says life is only “half complete” without his person by his side. He’s ready for his “single as a Pringle” era to be over and thinks he and Taylor share the same values that can lead them to an engagement at the end of this. When he’s not teaching kids how to ski or coaching his nephew’s football team, Josh enjoys swing dancing, watching football, and hitting the golf course with friends. Watch to see if Josh and Taylor are truly a match made in heaven! Fun Facts: Josh loves to indulge in a peanut butter burger. Josh is a Disney adult. Josh attends the Tulip Festival in Utah every year with his grandma. Kevin, 32Photo : Disney/Evan Mulling Miami, Fla.Physical Therapist Paging Dr. Love! Kevin is a physical therapist ready to find his connection with Taylor. Earning his doctorate degree has been one of his greatest achievements, but he’s hoping to top it by falling in love and someday raising a big family. After navigating a “fake” dating scene, Kevin is excited to settle down with the real deal. As a business owner, he values flexibility and freedom, and he’s lately embraced life as a self-proclaimed “yes man,” always up for a new adventure. Some of his favorite memories include sharing Cuban food and speaking Spanish with his family, and he’s hoping to create even more meaningful moments on this journey. Fingers crossed Kevin and Taylor find amor! Fun Facts: Kevin is happiest when he’s well fed. Kevin dreams of swimming with hammerhead sharks. Kevin loves to cry while listening to “Crash” by Dave Matthews Band. Lew, 32Photo : Disney/Evan Mulling Salt Lake City, UtahInsurance Tech Founder Standing at 6’8″, Lew is hard to miss and so is his big heart. This former basketball player is fun, funny and undeniably handsome. At a stage in life where many of his friends are married with kids, Lew loves being the fun uncle but is ready to find a love story of his own. He hopes to “fall in love with my best friend” and build a life and family together. A true romantic, Lew appreciates the little things, from handwritten notes to being fully present without cell phones in sight. Always up for a good adventure, he says he’s down for anything, so here’s hoping he’s ready for the adventure of a lifetime on “The Bachelorette.” Watch to see if Taylor and Lew hit it off! Fun Facts: Lew is a Belieber. Lew loves brunchin’ with the boys. Lew once won a twerking competition in Thailand. Malik, 30Photo : Disney/Evan Mulling Brooklyn, N.Y.Tech Executive Malik is ready for love at first bite. When he isn’t hard at work, this tech executive is a self-proclaimed foodie who loves to cook and eat his way through New York City. Outgoing, loyal and a true romantic, Malik wants his future wife to feel like “the most special girl in the world.” He’s especially excited that Taylor is a mom because Malik loves kids and can easily picture a future filled with school drop-offs, pickups and family time. He is very open to finding love in an unconventional way and can’t wait to see where his “Bachelorette” journey leads him. Will Malik and Taylor be the perfect pairing? Watch and find out! Fun Facts: Malik loves all things Halloween, especially costumes. Malik once had a mohawk, but he won’t show you pictures. Malik has a playlist for every occasion. Marcus, 28Photo : Disney/Evan Mulling Elmont, N.Y.Creative Director Taylor, get ready for a slam dunk with Marcus! This former basketball star-turned-creative director has a passion for fashion, music, and shooting hoops. Marcus is looking for a deep connection with someone he can build a future with and dreams of having a big family one day. Romance matters to him, and he’s all about feeling that undeniable spark and sharing conversations filled with effortless laughs. His idea of the perfect date? Watching the sunset over the Brooklyn skyline with a glass of wine, good music, and a stroll along the water. Will he leave a lasting impression on Taylor? Only time will tell. Fun Facts: Marcus once got attacked by a bird while on a run. Marcus loves a good rooftop vibe. Marcus’ favorite food is pancakes. Matt, 43Photo : Disney/Evan Mulling Carmel, Ind. Real Estate Broker If Taylor is looking for big dad energy, she’ll find it with Matt. This real estate broker is a proud father of three and ready to find his forever person. At 6’8″, Matt is a gentle giant who’s excited to build a future with someone who makes him feel truly chosen. Having grown up in Guatemala City and the U.K., Matt has traveled the world but says applying for this journey might be the most outrageous thing he’s ever done. Matt can’t wait to meet Taylor and share what brings him the most joy: seeing his kids smile and thrive. Could this be the start of one happy family? Fingers crossed! Fun Facts: In another life, Matt would love to be a fashion photographer in Paris. Matt’s favorite sound is his kids laughing. Nothing suits Matt like a suit. Michael B., 36Photo : Disney/Evan Mulling San Diego, Calif.Chiropractic Healer Michael can’t wait to see if there are good vibrations between him and Taylor. This chiropractic healer is all about good times, good energy and the right connection. In his free time, Michael loves to hang out with loved ones on the water (kiteboarding, anyone?) and is always down for an adventure. In addition to spending time with his big Greek family, he finds joy in meditation and helping others through his career. With his kind heart and playful energy, Michael loves to let his intuition guide him and is so excited to start this “Bachelorette” chapter. Let his journey to love begin! Fun Facts: Michael loves fantasy novels. Michael taught himself how to firespin. Michael says the bass moves his soul. Mike T., 36Photo : Disney/Evan Mulling Lavallette, N.J. Brand Protection Manager Mike sure is ready for love. This easygoing New Jersey native is a “reformed bad boy” who can’t wait to settle down. Watching his niece and nephew grow up makes him so excited to become a dad someday, and he’s ready to embrace a father-figure role. Mike is at his happiest with an iced coffee on the beach or at a Yankees game. On this journey, he hopes to fulfill his bucket list goal of finding the love of his life. When he’s not at work, Mike likes to spend his time walking by the ocean, working out, and watching his favorite TV show, “The Sopranos.” Fingers crossed he makes waves with Taylor! Fun Facts: Mike loves bonfires on the beach. Mike is an Aquaphor addict. Mike is his best self on a wedding dance floor. Richard, 35Photo : Disney/Evan Mulling Charleston, S.C. Photographer A picture-perfect love is waiting for Richard. With a kind demeanor and loyal heart, this artsy photographer is looking for someone who gives him that “I’m finally home” feeling. After seeing his friends settle down, Richard’s biggest goal in life is to get married and start a family of his own. His faith plays a central role in his life; and while he may be soft-spoken, his love for others speaks volumes. Nothing makes Richard happier than being around his people and exploring the outdoors, traveling, or helping those around him. Richard can’t wait to get to know Taylor and see if he’s the one who captures her heart. Fun Facts: Richard never misses a chance to go surfing. Richard loves hunting for shark teeth. Richard is thankful for Thanksgiving. Rod, 35Photo : Disney/Evan Mulling Austin, TexasEntrepreneur Serving up Mr. Right! Rod is a friendly entrepreneur with a big personality and an even bigger desire to find his forever partner. After serving in the military for 17 years, Rod shifted gears to start his own business supporting kids in the foster care system. His passion for helping others doesn’t stop there: He’s also a nutrition and physical fitness coach along with a seriously great cook. Community means everything to Rod, and he’s ready to grow his own by starting a family. Acts of service are his love language, so Taylor can expect to be truly cared for and spoiled. With his positive energy and undeniable charm, these two could really hit it off. Fun Facts: Rod loves a good aioli. Rod admits that it takes him a while to text back. Rod loves a Christmas movie marathon. Ronn, 28Photo : Disney/Evan Mulling San Francisco, Calif.Account Executive Ronn knows his worth and what he wants — and that’s Taylor. This account executive is looking for someone self-aware, kind, family-oriented, and capable of loving unconditionally, just like his parents. While Ronn can be analytical, he isn’t afraid to tap into his emotions and embrace his romantic side. Growing up in the Philippines, Tagalog was his first language, and he takes great pride in his Filipino cooking. He’s best friends with his mom and hopes to make her proud by going on her favorite show. When Ronn was younger, he would make origami orchids (his favorite flower) for girls he liked. Will he be able to swap an orchid for a rose? Watch and see! Fun Facts: Ronn has a 9-month-old betta fish named Finn. Ronn aspired to be Troy Bolton while growing up. Ronn thinks sloths are just pretending to be slow. Shane, 28Photo : Disney/Evan Mulling Atlanta, Ga. Private Wealth Planner Shane is an outgoing, athletic charmer with a heart of gold. The private wealth planner says he’s “never met a stranger,” thanks to his natural ability to connect with just about anyone. While Shane is a certified yapper who can talk one’s ear off for hours, he’s also an incredible listener. He proudly calls himself his future wife’s “ride or die” and is fiercely loyal to the people he loves. Shane is extremely close with his family and treasures any time spent together. When he’s not working, you’ll find him trying new restaurants, hitting the beach, or squeezing in a workout. Shane is totally a relationship guy, and Taylor may be the long-term love he’s been dreaming of! Fun Facts: Shane is a massive Uno enthusiast. If Shane has something stuck in his teeth, he begs that you tell him. Shane keeps a running note of the best breakfast burritos he’s ever had. Trenten, 35Photo : Disney/Evan Mulling San Juan Capistrano, Calif.Pro Athlete Trenten is a total keeper. A professional athlete and three-time Paralympian, Trenten knows what it takes to push through challenges, and now he’s chasing a gold medal of a different kind: love. When he’s not training, he is spending time with his German shepherd, Rango, listening to country music, or soaking up quality time with family. Trenten has been through a lot in life and approaches love with resilience, courage and care. He values simple, meaningful moments and dreams of sharing a quiet beach sunset with the right person by his side. Could Taylor be the love he’s been waiting for? Watch and see if their connection is worth its weight in gold. Fun Facts: Trenten’s dream superpower would be talking with dogs. Trenten lives with a Mamba Mentality. Trenten’s favorite flower is a snapdragon.
